description: This file is a main React component for a front-end application, specifically the App.tsx for a Next.js project. It manages the user interface for uploading documents, generating a persona draft, displaying the persona, and handling various states of the persona lifecycle. The code includes hooks, API calls, user interactions, and rendering logic for a persona builder interface.

classes.name: Experience
classes.description: Represents a work experience entry within a persona, including id, role, company, date, and description.

classes.name: CareerHighlight
classes.description: Represents a career highlight with optional source experience info.

classes.name: PersonaData
classes.description: Defines the shape of the persona object used across the component, including name, title, summary, skills, experiences, education, certifications, tools, industries, yearsOfExperience, and careerHighlights.

classes.name: UploadedFileData
classes.description: Represents an uploaded file with an ID and the File object.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a string array, filtering out non-string or empty strings.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object with at least one key.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Returns initials for a display label, taking the first character(s) of up to two words.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely accesses nested properties within an object based on a path array, returning the value and the path used.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs keys of objects for debugging orchestration payload shapes.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON data from an orchestration record, prioritizing various candidate paths.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend persona JSON into the UI's PersonaData format, supporting multiple shapes.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component managing the persona creation UI, document uploads, state transitions, and integration with backend APIs.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaData
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint string for persona data to detect changes.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaArtifact
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint string for archival persona artifacts to prevent redundant updates.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Handles initiating a new draft generation via API, including file uploads and orchestration calls.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves the current persona data to the backend API.

methods.name: handleRegenerateDraft
methods.description: Triggers regeneration of the draft persona for the current build.

methods.name: removeSkill
methods.description: Removes a skill from the persona.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a skill to the persona.

methods.name: handleProfileImageChange
methods.description: Handles updating the profile image in persona data.

methods.name: removeExperience
methods.description: Removes an experience entry from the persona.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Determines the file type label based on filename extension.
